grants.title: Hazard Mitigation Grants
grants.summary: Funds projects aimed at reducing or eliminating the effects of disasters in Pennsylvania.
grants.description: The Hazard Mitigation Grants program provides funding to support projects that reduce disaster risks and enhance community resilience. Eligible applicants include counties, municipalities, and other organizations within Pennsylvania. The program aims to better prepare communities for emergencies and disasters, ensuring safety and recovery. Applications can be submitted through the Pennsylvania Emergency Management Agency (PEMA). Detailed guidance and resources are available to assist applicants.
grants.eligibility_notes: Eligible applicants include counties, municipalities, and other organizations within Pennsylvania.
key_requirements: Applicants must be located in Pennsylvania.
Projects must aim to reduce disaster risks.
Applications must be submitted through PEMA.

grants.title: Public Assistance Program
grants.summary: This grant provides funding to help Pennsylvania communities recover from emergencies and disasters.
grants.description: The Public Assistance Program supports local and state governments, as well as certain private non-profits, in recovering from emergencies and disasters. The program provides financial assistance for debris removal, emergency protective measures, and the repair, replacement, or restoration of public infrastructure. Eligible applicants must demonstrate damages caused by a declared disaster. Applications can be submitted through the Pennsylvania Emergency Management Agency (PEMA).
grants.eligibility_notes: Eligible applicants include local and state governments, as well as certain private non-profits, that have been impacted by a declared disaster.
key_requirements: Applicant must be a local or state government or eligible private non-profit.
Damages must be caused by a declared disaster.
Funding must be used for eligible activities such as debris removal or infrastructure repair.
